8.2.1 WdgM_ConfigType
[SWS_WdgM_00355] Definition of datatype WdgM_ConfigType ⌈
Name
WdgM_ConfigType
Kind
Structure
implementation specific
Type
–
Elements
Comment
The contents of this structure depends on the configuration variant.
Description
This structure contains all post-build configurable parameters of the Watchdog Manager. A pointer
to this structure is passed to the Watchdog Manager initialization function for configuration.
Available via
WdgM.h
